name: Manika Plastech Limited
description: We are a design-led, precision engineered, rigid polymer packaging manufacturing company, catering to diversified critical industries such as energy storage, dairy and edible food products, paints, and chemicals. With focus on application specific performance, durability, product safety and efficiency, we have our product portfolio built around precision engineered solutions such as high-performance battery casings, pail & thinwall containers, each tailoring to serve industrial and consumer use cases.
